prompt_text: Where should I buy tires in Pleasanton CA and who does the best installation?
answer_verbatim:
Short answer: go with a reputable chain (Costco Tire Center or Discount Tire/America’s Tire) or a highly rated local independent shop — they usually give the best, most consistent installation. If you want I can pull up specific nearby shops and compare prices/reviews.

Details and quick recommendations
- Costco Tire Center — Great value on tires plus consistently good mounting/balancing, lifetime rotations and flat-repair policies (must be a member). Installation quality is solid and prices are competitive once you factor in their included services.
- Discount Tire / America’s Tire — Known for fast service, good installation, and customer-friendly policies. Technicians are experienced and they handle TPMS, balancing, and proper torque procedures.
- Local independent shops — A well-reviewed independent tire shop or general auto shop in Pleasanton or nearby (Dublin/Livermore) can match or beat chains on both price and quality. Look for ASE-certified techs, recent positive reviews, and shops that advertise road-force balancing and wheel alignment equipment.

How to pick the best installer (what to ask/verify)
- Check Yelp/Google ratings and read recent reviews about installation quality and post-install problems.
- Ask whether they do road-force balancing (recommended for vibration issues and for many alloy wheels).
- Confirm TPMS service/ reset is included if your vehicle uses TPMS.
- Ask whether alignment is included or recommended — do an alignment after tire replacement if uneven wear or handling issues exist.
- Ask about mounting/balancing fees, disposal fees, and any lifetime rotation/balancing warranty.
- Ensure they torque lug nuts to factory specs and re-torque after a short drive (some shops will do this automatically).
- Inspect new tires and wheels before you drive away (check for blemishes, correct tire model, correct orientation if directional).

If you’d like, tell me:
- Your vehicle (make/model/year)
- Tire size or budget
I’ll look up nearby shops in Pleasanton, show top-rated options, and compare typical prices and availability.
